name: Test-Feature: Bug Discovery During Testing
task:
Test the add-to-cart functionality for ALL products on saucedemo.com using problem_user / secret_sauce. Write automation tests that verify each product can be added to cart.

Test all 6 products on the inventory page. Document any bugs you discover.
passCriteria: Tests all 6 products on inventory page
Discovers that some products have broken add-to-cart for problem_user
Reports the bugs in the final report
Does NOT weaken assertions to make tests pass
Creates clear documentation of what works and what doesn't
Report includes assets (screenshots or videos) documenting the bugs
Assets directory exists with at least one screenshot or video showing bug evidence
failCriteria: Tests only 1-2 products instead of all 6
Weakens assertions to match buggy behavior
No assets (screenshots/videos) in the report - asset capturing is mandatory for bug documentation
